import oge
oge.initialize()
service = oge.Service()

# 1. 加载 Landsat 8 TOA 影像（武汉东北部）
ls8 = service.getCoverage(
    coverageID="LC08_122039_20151002",
    productID="LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_TOA"
)

# 选择绿色波段 (B3)
target_band = service.getProcess("Coverage.selectBands").execute(ls8, ["B3"])

# 2. 获取并打印原始投影信息
crs = target_band.projection()
print('原始投影与分辨率:', crs)

# 3. 应用中值滤波（以像素为单位进行 3x3 邻域滤波，无需强制重投影）
kernel = service.getProcess("Kernel.circle").execute(1.5, "pixels")
final_band = service.getProcess("Coverage.reduceNeighborhood").execute(
    target_band, "median", kernel
)

# 4. 可视化参数（灰度拉伸 0.0 ~ 0.3）
vis_params = {
    "min": 0.0,
    "max": 0.3,
    "palette": ["#1f1f1f", "#5a5a5a", "#9a9a9a", "#d9d9d9", "#ffffff"]
}

# 5. 添加图层到地图
target_band.styles(vis_params).getMap("原始绿光波段 (B3)")
final_band.styles(vis_params).getMap("中值滤波平滑波段")

# 6. 设置地图中心（武汉东北部）
oge.mapclient.centerMap(114.30, 30.61, 10)

import oge
oge.initialize()
service = oge.Service()

# 1. 加载同一轨道相邻的两景 Landsat 8 影像
image_a = service.getCoverage(
    coverageID="LC08_123036_20160504",
    productID="LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_TOA"
)
image_b = service.getCoverage(
    coverageID="LC08_123037_20160504",
    productID="LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_TOA"
)

# 2. 选择绿色波段 (B3)
band_a = service.getProcess("Coverage.selectBands").execute(image_a, ["B3"])
band_b = service.getProcess("Coverage.selectBands").execute(image_b, ["B3"])

# 3. 合并两景影像（无缝拼接）
# 将两个单波段 Coverage 组合为列表，通过 CoverageCollection.mosaic 实现拼接
cov_col = service.getCoverageCollection(
    productID="LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_TOA",
    bbox=[113.0, 33.0, 116.0, 35.0],
    datetime=["2016-05-04 00:00:00", "2016-05-04 23:59:59"]
)
mosaic_band = service.getProcess("CoverageCollection.mosaic").execute(cov_col)

# 4. 可视化参数
vis_params = {
    "min": 0.0,
    "max": 0.3,
    "palette": ["#1f1f1f", "#5a5a5a", "#9a9a9a", "#d9d9d9", "#ffffff"]
}

# 5. 添加图层到地图

band_a.styles(vis_params).getMap("单景 A (Row 36)")
band_b.styles(vis_params).getMap("单景 B (Row 37)")

oge.initialize()
service = oge.Service()

# 定义研究区范围（武汉沿江片区）
study_geom = service.getProcess("Geometry.Polygon").execute([
    [114.24, 30.52], [114.24, 30.59], [114.35, 30.59], [114.35, 30.52], [114.24, 30.52]
], "EPSG:4326", "true")

# 定义支撑通道A（沿江主通道，缓冲区单位：米）
support_a_geom = service.getProcess("Geometry.LineString").execute([
    [114.245, 30.545], [114.29, 30.552], [114.34, 30.558]
], "EPSG:4326", "true")
support_a_buffer = service.getProcess("Geometry.buffer").execute(support_a_geom, 800)

# 定义支撑通道B（向内陆连接通道）
support_b_geom = service.getProcess("Geometry.LineString").execute([
    [114.275, 30.525], [114.29, 30.552], [114.315, 30.585]
], "EPSG:4326", "true")
support_b_buffer = service.getProcess("Geometry.buffer").execute(support_b_geom, 800)

# 定义关键节点（中华路1号码头）并建立排除带
key_node = service.getProcess("Geometry.Point").execute([114.2885828, 30.5512112], "EPSG:4326")
exclusion_buffer = service.getProcess("Geometry.buffer").execute(key_node, 1000)

# 计算各区域在研究范围内的部分
support_a_in_study = service.getProcess("Geometry.intersection").execute(support_a_buffer, study_geom)
support_b_in_study = service.getProcess("Geometry.intersection").execute(support_b_buffer, study_geom)
exclusion_in_study = service.getProcess("Geometry.intersection").execute(exclusion_buffer, study_geom)

# 计算双支撑同时满足的优先候选区基础
priority_base = service.getProcess("Geometry.intersection").execute(support_a_in_study, support_b_in_study)

# 计算仅满足单一支撑的备用候选区基础
backup_a_base = service.getProcess("Geometry.difference").execute(support_a_in_study, support_b_in_study)
backup_b_base = service.getProcess("Geometry.difference").execute(support_b_in_study, support_a_in_study)

# 从各区域中排除关键节点排除带
priority_zone = service.getProcess("Geometry.difference").execute(priority_base, exclusion_in_study)
backup_a_zone = service.getProcess("Geometry.difference").execute(backup_a_base, exclusion_in_study)
backup_b_zone = service.getProcess("Geometry.difference").execute(backup_b_base, exclusion_in_study)

# 计算不满足任一支撑条件的空白区
blank_zone = service.getProcess("Geometry.difference").execute(
    service.getProcess("Geometry.difference").execute(study_geom, support_a_in_study),
    support_b_in_study
)

# 构建备用候选区要素集合
backup_a_feature = service.getProcess("Feature.loadFromGeometry").execute(backup_a_zone, {"name": "backup_a"})
backup_b_feature = service.getProcess("Feature.loadFromGeometry").execute(backup_b_zone, {"name": "backup_b"})
backup_zone_fc = service.getProcess("FeatureCollection.loadFromFeatureList").execute([backup_a_feature, backup_b_feature])

support_a_feature.styles(["#FFCC00"]).getMap("支撑约束区A")

)

aspect = service.getProcess("Coverage.add").execute(rad_to_deg, 180)

end_geom = service.getProcess("Geometry.Point").execute([114.328842, 30.542172], "EPSG:4326")

start = service.getProcess("Feature.loadFromGeometry").execute(start_geom, {"name": "start"})
end = service.getProcess("Feature.loadFromGeometry").execute(end_geom, {"name": "end"})

# 3. 创建缓冲区（使用 Feature.buffer 算子）
start_buffer = service.getProcess("Feature.buffer").execute(start, 100)
end_buffer = service.getProcess("Feature.buffer").execute(end, 100)

# 4. 构建模拟道路段（LineString）
corridor_coords = [
    [114.337475, 30.558570],
    [114.333000, 30.550000],
    [114.328842, 30.542172]
]
corridor = service.getProcess("Geometry.LineString").execute(corridor_coords, "EPSG:4326")
road_feature = service.getProcess("Feature.loadFromGeometry").execute(corridor, {"name": "main_path"})
road_collection = service.getProcess("FeatureCollection.loadFromFeatureList").execute([road_feature])

# 5. 计算道路几何长度（米）

time_30 = length_value / speed_30

speed_limit_feature = service.getProcess("Feature.set").execute(road_feature, {"time": time_30})
